# `aube activate`

- **Usage:** `aube activate <SHELL>`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Emit shell activation code for runtime tool shims

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube activate zsh
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-runtime) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<SHELL>`** — Shell to emit activation code for

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
